title: Assembly of fixed-object rectifications over sets
statement:
Let $\mathbf V=\operatorname{Ch}(\mathbf Z)$ with its projective monoidal model structure [lem-coef-projective-chains-monoidal-model], let $W$ be its quasi-isomorphisms, and let $\mathcal D=\mathbf V[W^{-1}]_\infty$. Let $\operatorname{Cat}(\mathbf V)$ be all small strict enriched categories (a set of objects, mapping complexes, associative unital chain-map compositions) and enriched functors, allowing arbitrary functions on objects. For each set $S$, take the comparison $\eta_S$ of [lem-coef-fixed-object-enriched-rectification]. Let $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathrm{cat}}(\mathcal D)_{\mathrm{Set}}$ be categorical algebras with discrete sets of objects: its fibre at $S$ is $\operatorname{Alg}_{\Delta_S^{\mathrm{op}}}(\mathcal D)$, and its morphisms over $f:S\to T$ are algebra maps $A\to f^*B$. Let $\mathrm{FFB}$ be enriched functors bijective on objects and quasi-isomorphisms on every mapping complex. Then the coherently natural fixed-object comparisons assemble to an equivalence over the nerve of the category of sets
$$\eta:\operatorname{Cat}(\mathbf V)[\mathrm{FFB}^{-1}]_\infty\simeq\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathrm{cat}}(\mathcal D)_{\mathrm{Set}}.$$
Its restriction to every fibre is $\eta_S$. On any dg functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ its object function is that of $F$, and its mapping-object maps, under the replacement comparisons, are the images in $\mathcal D$ of $\mathcal A(x,y)\to\mathcal B(Fx,Fy)$. The equivalence is one of infinity-categories, including the coherent naturality of these identifications. The strict total category also has a model structure whose weak equivalences are $\mathrm{FFB}$, whose fibrations are mappingwise projective fibrations, and in which every object is fibrant. Morphisms of its localized homotopy category can be represented by roofs $A\xleftarrow{\sim}QA\to B$, with $QA$ cofibrant and the backward map a trivial fibration. Thus every component of a mapping space in this localization is represented by such a roof.
